research.name: Launch UI
research.note: Landing page blocks for React, shadcn/ui and Tailwind with a floating toolbar that restyles the whole page.

effects: Floating theme toolbar that switches accent color, corner radius, light or dark mode and background grid lines across the whole page, with a Shuffle button
Hero with tilted app screen mockups lit by a colored radial glow
